title: Combat basics
summary: Mob levels, nameplates, damage numbers, Elites, Valor Marks, Dread Fangs, Nightmare Cores, the Training Dummy and Combat XP.

s.x: Every hostile mob in the survival world has a level. The higher the level, the more health it has, the harder it hits and the more it pays when it dies. This page explains how levels are set, what you see in a fight, and what a kill rewards you with. Kestrel Vane, the weaponsmith in Skyhaven, is the Combat Master and buys most of what drops.
A hostile mob gets its level when it spawns. Mobs in the hub never get one.

Mobs you spawn with a spawn egg or a command are levelled too, so test mobs behave like real ones.
When you can see a levelled mob and it is within 20 blocks, it shows a plate like

. The level is green below 10, yellow below 20, gold below 30, red below 40 and dark red from 40. The health is on the same scale as your own health bar (5 SkyRPG health is 1 vanilla point) and turns yellow below half and red below a quarter. Bosses stronger than vanilla health allows show their real health, not the capped number. You can switch plates off in Settings under HUD ("Mob nameplates").

Swap a piece of gear, hit the dummy for ten seconds, and compare the DPS. It is the quickest way to find out whether a reforge or an enchant is worth it.
